## Runtime

- Smoke cell rho=1, eta=0.3, r=1, T=1000: mean 1.269 s per run, max 2.192 s; by arm A0 1.388 s, A1 1.791 s, A2 0.628 s.
- Projected EXP-002 (540 runs): 12.5 min serial, about 1.6 min with 8 workers; most expensive cell 11.504 s per run. Method: per-run cost of each (cell, arm) = smoke mean for the arm (T=1000) x ratio of burn-in-scan mean runtimes (T=500) between that cell and the smoke cell; linear parallel scaling assumed.
